name: OmaTainment
author: makeitcount.tech
description: OmaTainment: Music, YouTube, Movies and Series in the top bar. YouTube music with queue and favourites, YouTube video, and Movies/Series via Remux with source picker, automatic failover for debrid links that aren't ready, pop-out/fullscreen player and phone hand-off.
